relations.name: source_invoice
relations.meaning: A represented invoice row exactly as recorded in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse invoices.json; copy scalar fields without normalization of billed_name.

relations.name: source_crm_account
relations.meaning: A CRM account record exactly as recorded in CRM sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse crm.csv; copy fields without merging or canonicalizing account_name.

relations.name: source_registry_entity
relations.meaning: A company registry row exactly as recorded in the registry source.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite sources/company_registry.csv by company_number row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse company_registry.csv; copy fields without cross-row merge.

relations.name: source_contract_document
relations.meaning: A contract or statement-of-work document identified by its filename stem in sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite one file under sources/contracts/ by path.
relations.construction_rule: Enumerate sources/contracts/*.md; contract_stem is filename without .md extension.

relations.name: source_commercial_note
relations.meaning: A paragraph of internal commercial notes preserved as an authoritative source observation.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite sources/commercial_notes.md by paragraph index.
relations.construction_rule: Split commercial_notes.md on blank lines; index paragraphs from zero.

relations.name: contract_counterparty_name
relations.meaning: The counterparty legal name stated in a contract document header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite the Counterparty line in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: Parse the Counterparty field from contract header; bind contract referent to contract_stem.

relations.name: contract_effective_date
relations.meaning: The effective date stated in a contract document header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite the Effective line in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Effective field as verbatim source text.

relations.name: contract_term_text
relations.meaning: The term or duration statement stated in a contract document header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite the Term line in the contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Term field as verbatim source text without interpreting renewal mechanics.

relations.name: contract_expiry_statement
relations.meaning: An explicit expiry or non-renewal statement present in a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite Expiry or equivalent explicit expiry language in the contract file.
relations.construction_rule: Emit only when source states explicit expiry; set not_renewed when source says not renewed or expired.

relations.name: contract_section_clause
relations.meaning: A contract section heading and its clause body as observed in source markdown.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple must cite the section heading and following text in the contract file.
relations.construction_rule: Split contract markdown on ## headings; preserve heading and body text verbatim.

relations.name: invoice_is_open
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice status field records it as open versus paid or closed.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from source_invoice.status with grounding pointer to the invoice row.
relations.construction_rule: is_open is true when source_invoice.status equals open; otherwise false.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One row per source_invoice tuple.

relations.name: billing_identifier
relations.meaning: The mandated billing identifier form billing:<billed_name> for a recorded billed name.
relations.grounding_contract: identifier must be deterministically formed from billed_name appearing in source_invoice.
relations.construction_rule: identifier equals billing: concatenated with exact billed_name string from billing source.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One row per distinct billed_name in source_invoice.

relations.name: crm_identifier
relations.meaning: The mandated CRM identifier form crm:<crm_account_id> for a CRM account.
relations.grounding_contract: identifier must be deterministically formed from crm_account_id in source_crm_account.
relations.construction_rule: identifier equals crm: concatenated with crm_account_id.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One row per source_crm_account tuple.

relations.name: registry_identifier
relations.meaning: The mandated registry identifier form registry:<company_number> for a registry row.
relations.grounding_contract: identifier must be deterministically formed from company_number in source_registry_entity.
relations.construction_rule: identifier equals registry: concatenated with company_number.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One row per source_registry_entity tuple.

relations.name: contract_identifier
relations.meaning: The mandated contract identifier form contract:<contract_stem> for a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: identifier must be deterministically formed from contract_stem in source_contract_document.
relations.construction_rule: identifier equals contract: concatenated with contract_stem.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One row per source_contract_document tuple.

relations.name: clause_encodes_feature
relations.meaning: A contract clause text encodes a specific contractual feature independent of diligence policy thresholds.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in contract_section_clause text and cite the section heading; do not infer features absent from clause language.
relations.construction_rule: Read assignment, change-of-control, exclusivity, and term sections; assert feature when clause language encodes it.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates are contract_section_clause rows whose headings mention Assignment, Change of control, Exclusivity, or Term.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether ambiguous clause language encodes a listed feature.

relations.name: contract_in_force
relations.meaning: Whether a contract or statement of work is expired versus in force based on grounded dates and term statements in sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in contract_effective_date, contract_term_text, contract_expiry_statement, and explicit expired language in the contract file.
relations.construction_rule: Apply source dates and explicit expiry or not-renewed statements; do not treat silence as expiration.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent with compiled date and term observations.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether temporal status cannot be determined from grounded dates and term text alone.

relations.name: contract_continues_by_structure
relations.meaning: How a contract's stated term structure provides ongoing continuation absent explicit expiry.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in contract_term_text and any term-related clause_encodes_feature rows.
relations.construction_rule: Classify continuation from verbatim term statements and renewal clauses without applying Purpose C dependency thresholds.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent with contract_term_text.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether term language establishes auto-renewal, rolling continuation, or month-to-month continuation.

relations.name: source_asserts_same_entity
relations.meaning: Authoritative source text explicitly states two named records refer to the same legal entity.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in commercial_notes, registry text, or contract header where source explicitly equates names or entities.
relations.construction_rule: Assert only when a source sentence positively identifies two labels as the same legal entity.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Pairs of name strings co-mentioned in source_commercial_note or co-occurring as registry legal_name variants on one company_number.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether source text is an explicit same-entity assertion versus mere similarity.

relations.name: source_asserts_distinct_entity
relations.meaning: Authoritative source text explicitly states two named records are different legal entities.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in commercial_notes or registry rows where source explicitly distinguishes entities.
relations.construction_rule: Assert only when a source sentence positively identifies two labels as distinct legal entities.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Pairs of similar trade or operating names mentioned together in source_commercial_note paragraphs.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether source text is an explicit distinct-entity assertion versus mere co-mention.

relations.name: mechanical_legal_form_match
relations.meaning: Two name strings are exact legal-form variants tied to the same registry company_number grounding.
relations.grounding_contract: Both names must appear in sources tied to the same company_number in source_registry_entity or contract grounded to that registry row.
relations.construction_rule: Normalize only standard legal suffix variants (Ltd/Limited, Inc./Incorporated, LLC) when company_number linkage is grounded.

relations.name: commercial_relationship_path
relations.meaning: A commercially relevant connection path linking CRM account, invoice billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry entity for one relationship.
relations.grounding_contract: Each role must be grounded in CRM, billing, contract, registry, or commercial_notes observations that participate in the same commercial relationship.
relations.construction_rule: Assemble paths from CRM accounts, their invoices, governing MSAs or SOWs, and registry candidates without applying Purpose B merge policy.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: CRM accounts with status active or churned plus invoices sharing domain, name overlap, or explicit note linkage; registry candidates are rows whose legal_name appears in the path or notes.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which contract governs a CRM–billing pair or which registry row is the candidate legal entity.

relations.name: required_reconciliation_link
relations.meaning: An identifier pair that Purpose B must emit with an explicit epistemic verdict to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry along a commercial relationship.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from commercial_relationship_path and mandated identifier forms; not all pairwise combinations in the universe.
relations.construction_rule: Enumerate left/right pairs along each commercial_relationship_path using billing_identifier, crm_identifier, contract_identifier, and registry_identifier.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Adjacent pairs on each path: crm–billing, billing–contract counterparty name or contract id, billing–registry, contract–registry, crm–contract.

relations.name: counterparty_identity_verdict
relations.meaning: Purpose B policy verdict on whether two mandated identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, distinct entities, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground positive SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT in world evidence relations; UNRESOLVED when policy withholds judgment.
relations.construction_rule: Apply Purpose B policies: no fuzzy global merge, mechanical legal-form match allowed, similar trade names distinct by default.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per required_reconciliation_link tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Insufficient grounded evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT under Purpose B policy.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: Purpose A verdict linking a represented invoice to a governing contract and counterparty identity as asserted or unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground asserted associations in billing, contract, notes, and identity evidence; unresolved when billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently joined.
relations.construction_rule: association is asserted only when invoice-to-contract and billed-name-to-counterparty linkage is confident; otherwise unresolved without treating missing linkage as negative.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Each source_invoice paired with candidate contracts from commercial_relationship_path or explicit note linkage.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether billed_name and contract counterparty confidently denote the same party for this invoice.

relations.name: contract_active_for_exposure
relations.meaning: Purpose A policy verdict that a contract counts as active for acquisition-exposure testing.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in contract_in_force and contract_expiry_statement; expired SOWs are not active under Purpose A policy.
relations.construction_rule: active is false for expired statements of work; otherwise follow grounded in_force status.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract_identifier.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether temporal status is insufficient to classify active versus expired for Purpose A.

relations.name: contract_acquisition_relevant_term
relations.meaning: Purpose A policy verdict that a contract bears at least one acquisition-relevant condition among the three enumerated families.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in clause_encodes_feature rows for change-of-control and assignment families.
relations.construction_rule: has_relevant_term when any Purpose A family matches: CoC consent or notice, CoC termination right, or assignment consent or notice including affiliate-only or competitor-prohibited assignment.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Contracts with any clause_encodes_feature in CoC or assignment families.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether compiled clause features satisfy Purpose A acquisition-relevance threshold.

relations.name: invoice_exposure_qualifies
relations.meaning: Purpose A verdict that a represented invoice belongs in the contractual revenue exposure report.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice_contract_association, contract_active_for_exposure, and contract_acquisition_relevant_term.
relations.construction_rule: qualifies when invoice has asserted or unresolved association to a contract that is active for exposure and bears acquisition-relevant terms; unresolved association rows still qualify for output.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Every source_invoice with any candidate contract linkage.

relations.name: contract_obligation_kind
relations.meaning: Purpose C classification mapping a contract to one of the closed obligation_kinds vocabulary entries.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in clause_encodes_feature and contract_continues_by_structure aligned to exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term.
relations.construction_rule: kind must be exactly exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term per Purpose C vocabulary.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Contracts with exclusivity_commitment, auto_renewal_term, or rolling_term_period features.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether clause and term evidence supports a specific obligation_kinds label.

relations.name: counterparty_current_relationship
relations.meaning: Purpose C policy verdict on whether a counterparty has a current commercial relationship via open invoice or continuing active contract.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in invoice_is_open, contract_in_force, and contract_continues_by_structure; exclude expired contracts and one-off paid historical invoices without active contract.
relations.construction_rule: has_current_relationship is true when an open invoice exists or an in-force contract auto-renews or continues on rolling or month-to-month term.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Counterparties appearing in commercial_relationship_path with open invoices or in-force contracts.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether current-relationship prong cannot be assessed because identity or contract status is unresolved.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_status
relations.meaning: Purpose C verdict that a counterparty–contract pair is commercially dependent or unresolved when identity joins block assessment.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground both prongs: counterparty_current_relationship and contract_obligation_kind on the same contract; propagate UNRESOLVED identity from counterparty_identity_verdict.
relations.construction_rule: status is dependent when both prongs hold; unresolved when any required join or prong assessment is unresolved; never emit false negative from missing identity.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Each counterparty–contract pair from commercial_relationship_path with in-force or candidate obligation features.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether dependency can be asserted when invoice–contract or identity linkage remains unresolved.

relations.name: dependency_open_invoices
relations.meaning: Open invoices tied to a counterparty–contract dependency row when invoice association is asserted.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice_is_open and invoice_contract_association with asserted association.
relations.construction_rule: Emit invoice_id for open invoices linked to the contract row; omit or leave empty when association is unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Open invoices sharing commercial_relationship_path with the contract and counterparty.
